summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with parametrized valid and invalid cases. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (43 passed). Nothing was committed, and no existing files were changed. Not verified: mypy is not installed in the venv, so the type-ignore placement is unchecked; black and isort were not run, though no line exceeds 88 columns.
